PLAY · BEGINNING, MIDDLE, END

Mouse’s Story Retelling Train

Mouse baked cookies! Tap the pictures in story order to load the train: beginning, middle, and end.

Tap the story in order — beginning, middle, end.

The retelling train is loaded!

Mix the batter, bake the cookies, then munch — beginning, middle, end.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains beginning, middle, end on the story picture itself: the questions are spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to say the answer out loud before tapping — the retelling is where comprehension really grows.

Prefer paper? The Mouse’s Story Retelling Train worksheet prints the same story with room to retell and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
